summary: Frontend-only regression of the new JWIPC-style header, rebuilt mega menu, removed lineup section, and new /news index. 24 of 25 checks passed across desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844), dark + light themes. One real functional bug found: the APPLICATIONS nav item (and the footer 'Applications' link) does not scroll anywhere because the Home applications section only has data-testid="applications-section" and no matching DOM id, while Header.goSection()/Footer use document.getElementById().

ui_bugs.issue: Nav 'APPLICATIONS' click does nothing (scrollY stays 0). Header.goSection('applications-section') calls document.getElementById('applications-section'), but the Home section (Home.jsx L317) only sets data-testid, not id. Fix: add id="applications-section" to that <section> (or query by [data-testid]).

Same root cause: getElementById('applications-section') returns null so it falls back to window.location.href='/', causing a full page reload back to the top of the homepage instead of scrolling to the section.

action_items: Add id="applications-section" to the applications <section> in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx (L317) so header nav APPLICATIONS and footer Applications scroll correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: goSection()/Footer rely on DOM ids while sections are only tagged with data-testid — brittle. Prefer a shared SECTION_IDS constant and set both id and data-testid on every scroll target.
goPage() anchor scroll uses a fixed 1000ms setTimeout (Design & Manufacturing works today but is timing-dependent); consider useEffect on location.hash instead.
Home page 'contact' works only because the Footer sets id="contact"; document this coupling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASS: hero accordion hover expand (232->784px) + subcat pill nav; lineup-section fully removed (count 0); all 7 nav testids present; nav-about-latios/-support/-news route correctly; nav-design-manufacturing lands on /about scrolled to about-different (scrollY 1640); nav-contact-us and mega-quick-contact scroll to footer (scrollY 5995); mega menu opens from nav-products and mobile menu-toggle (4 cats, 14 subcats, 6 featured apps); mega-search-input 'promax'/'archer' returns results and navigates to model pages (desktop + mobile); mega-cat-laptops, mega-sub-laptops-2 -> /laptops, mega-app-education -> /applications/education; quick links -> /compare, /news, /support; /news index renders 7 cards and detail pages render h1 (previous /:category collision is FIXED); standalone search overlay works; theme toggle works and mega menu stays dark (rgba(5,5,5,0.98)) with readable /news in light theme; chat widget opens/closes; model page tabs are data-testid=model-tab-* (2 tabs) and switch fine. ONLY open issue = applications-section missing DOM id.
rca_of_the_issue: Header.goSection(id) and Footer's section button both resolve targets via document.getElementById(id). The homepage applications section was tagged with data-testid="applications-section" but never given id="applications-section", so the lookup returns null: the header click silently no-ops and the footer button falls back to a full-page navigation to '/'. Repro: load /, scrollTo(0,0), click [data-testid=nav-applications], wait 2s -> window.scrollY remains 0.
